input.description: Create approval marker then wait 7 seconds

claude_permission_smoke.limit: Tool request and successful result bracket 44.154 seconds, including execution. No approval-resolution timestamp appears in these records. The fact independently records that this command prompted.

claude-code.note: The primary host's Claude personal smoke f169ae86 (transcript permissionMode default; no allow rule in the home's settings names sleep): Bash 'sleep 7' ran with no permission dialog, while 'touch approval.marker && sleep 7' in the same session asked. A command meant to raise a permission prompt needs more than a plain sleep; a file write did it here. Which other commands run unasked, and why, was not probed.
Run main: PostToolUse fired for each allowed Bash, Write and Agent call, root and subagent, with tool_response and duration_ms; none fired for a denied call.

codex.note: Run main and spawn-direct: PostToolUse fired for each allowed nested exec_command (Bash) and apply_patch call and for spawn_agent and wait_agent, root and worker; none for a denied call and none for the outer exec. A yielded exec_command gets no PostToolUse at the yield: in run cancel it came when nested write_stdin ended the process (exit 130), with an empty tool_response; in run all-tools a yielded process that ended on its own got none at all. An empty Bash tool_response is no sign of a yield: a completed true gives the same empty string (fixture codex-exec_command-yield.json). Nested write_stdin and the wait tool get none.

claude-code.note: Run main: the background subagent's Bash PreToolUse and PostToolUse carried agent_id (also agent_type general-purpose) and the root's session_id; the root's calls carry no agent_id. SubagentStart and SubagentStop carry the same agent_id, which equals the Agent tool_response's agentId.

codex.note: Run main: the worker's nested exec_command PreToolUse and PostToolUse (tool_name Bash) carried agent_id (the worker's thread id, agent_type default) and the root's session_id; the root's calls carry no agent_id. The spawn_agent tool_response names only the task name (/root/probe_worker), so the id first appears at SubagentStart. No hook payload in any run links a task_name to an agent_id: spawn_agent's tool_input carries the bare task_name and its PostToolUse response /root/<task_name>, interrupt_agent, send_message and followup_task take the name as target, and SubagentStart carries agent_id with no name. The worker rollout that SubagentStart's transcript_path names holds the link in its first line (session_meta source.subagent.thread_spawn.agent_path /root/<task_name>), read after the run; whether it is there when SubagentStart fires is not shown. Fixture: tools/fixtures/turn-pause/hooks/codex-spawn_agent.json.

claude-code.note: Every tool claude/probes/turn-pause-probe.py runs main, cron and cron2 called (Agent, Bash, CronCreate, CronDelete, ScheduleWakeup, ToolSearch, Write, and subagents' Bash) fired PreToolUse. Tools not called are not covered.

codex.note: exec: no hook in any run. Run cancel: tools.write_stdin({session_id: 83217, chars: "\u0003"}) inside exec interrupted a running exec_command session (exit_code 130), and wait({cell_id: "5", terminate: true}) terminated a running exec cell (Script terminated); neither fired any hook event. Both stop work unseen, and write_stdin can also send arbitrary input to a running session unseen. Fixtures: tools/fixtures/turn-pause/hooks/codex-write_stdin.json and codex-wait.json (no records).
